Problem: Students need a clean subject-scoped entry point and may otherwise see mixed academic content.
Solution: Let a student start with zero subjects and add courses through Board → Qualification → Subject → Curriculum/Specification Version; show only enrolled subjects on the global dashboard.
Implementation Notes: Create subject enrollment model/read API, add/remove subject flow, subject switcher, active-subject context, server-side authorization and curriculum isolation.
Requirements: Board, Qualification, Subject, CurriculumVersion identity; authenticated student
Agent Notes: Long-term product boundary; does not expand Cycle 1.

Problem: Revision, practice, tutoring and assessment features need a single coherent home per course.
Solution: Clicking a subject opens a self-contained workspace: Dashboard, Revision Notes, Exam Questions, Past Papers, Flashcards, Target Test, Mock Exams, Smart Lesson, Tutor, Knowledge Graph.
Implementation Notes: Route all subject features through explicit subject/curriculum context; never rely on a global topic name or last-selected course.
Agent Notes: Save My Exams is UX reference only; SyllabAI owns the architecture/content.

Problem: Unit/Topic/SubTopic is too coarse for detailed board specifications whose actual learning objectives are numbered (1.1, 1.2, 1.3...).
Solution: Make SpecificationPoint a first-class canonical curriculum object preserving official code, verbatim objective, ordering, applicability and provenance.
Implementation Notes: Extend curriculum ingestion/schema and KG hierarchy: Board → Qualification → Subject → CurriculumVersion → Unit/Section → Topic/SubTopic → SpecificationPoint. Never invent numbering.
Requirements: Official current specification; provenance; validation workflow; curriculum versioning
Agent Notes: Canonical bridge for notes, questions, learner evidence and adaptive features.

Problem: Existing revision notes are already structured by specification point, but the product needs a durable canonical mapping.
Solution: Map Revision Notes, Flashcards, examples and Smart Lesson steps to one or more SpecificationPoints with provenance and validation state.
Implementation Notes: ResourceLink table/edge; support many-to-many mappings; preserve source document/page/section where available; allow reviewed vs suggested links.
Agent Notes: Existing notes should be migrated/tagged to official points rather than flattened into broad topics.

Problem: Past-paper questions currently have topic-level placement, but precise objective mapping is needed for adaptive practice and reporting.
Solution: Allow QuestionVersion/QuestionPart to map to one or more SpecificationPoints; preserve uncertain/unreviewed mappings.
Implementation Notes: Suggested mapping pipeline + teacher/SME validation; no forced single tag; retain multi-concept coverage.
Agent Notes: Future extension of the existing multi-topic question direction; unvalidated mappings never become authoritative.

Problem: The subject KG must show official structure while also exposing personalized mastery, misconceptions, confidence, fluency and review state.
Solution: Build a subject-scoped graph read model with SpecificationPoints as fine-grained anchors and learner state as a separate overlay; aggregate upward to SubTopic/Topic/Unit for summaries.
Implementation Notes: Extend recursive graph traversal/read model, prerequisite edges and personalized overlays without mutating curriculum. Visualizer can group/collapse levels for readability.
Agent Notes: Knowledge graph is structural backbone; learner state is time-aware overlay.

Problem: Students need a guided study path that adapts from performance rather than manually choosing separate resources.
Solution: Choose a topic/specification area and construct an adaptive path using Exam Questions, Revision Notes and Flashcards; use observed performance to alter the next step.
Implementation Notes: Start with deterministic rules over measured mastery, misconception, confidence, fluency and coverage; later research richer policies. Every step must cite the graph node/resource it targets.
Requirements: F-166, F-167, F-168, F-169, learner model, assessment
Agent Notes: Save My Exams-inspired product capability; SyllabAI adaptation must remain grounded in learner evidence.
